title: Colosseum of the Damned Jam
description: SpongeBob SquarePants stands on a globe stage in front of the ruined Colosseum, playing guitar amid a chaotic apocalyptic party. He is surrounded by costumed characters including Squidward as a grim reaper, a flaming skeleton with a trumpet, and an astronaut with a trombone, while a banner overhead reads 'WELCOME TO THE COLOSSEUM OF THE DAMNED JAM' against a burning red sky.
